summary: FBRX Endpoint Basic and Ultra, license keys that join FBRX Command by themselves, a Ctrl+Alt+Z clipboard history, finer texture control and new chat surprises.
notes: Two products: FBRX Endpoint Basic (everyday tools and the agent, plain light or dark look) and FBRX Endpoint Ultra, turned on by a license key. The Advanced switch is gone.
A license key from FBRX Command joins the computer to its tenant on its own; the tenant decides Basic or Ultra.
Macros are keyboard shortcuts now: Ctrl+Alt+Z opens your clipboard history (W/S to move, Tab and ~ for paste formats, type to search, Enter pastes). Snippets are the text you paste from the / menu.
Textures have a strength slider (0 to 100%), start softer, and the weave is smaller again.
Ultra: say "Talk to me, Goose" for your wingman on the radio, and "Have you seen my stapler?" for the jargon manager. Three new trophies and a new story in the Library.
The Silly Goose keeps just his aviator goggles, drops the odd feather and boops your pointer instead of taking it.
